headline: Singapore AI Data Center Firm DayOne Pauses US IPO Plans
summary: Singapore-headquartered DayOne has reportedly put its US initial public offering on hold due to rising global stock market volatility and investor doubts over artificial intelligence capital returns.
why: DayOne is an artificial intelligence data center infrastructure operator based in Southeast Asia.

impacts.name: DayOne
impacts.why: Pausing IPO plans delays planned equity capital raising in US public markets.
